heard: Amon was twenty-two when he began to rule He reigned two years in the city of Jerusalem His mother was Meshulamith from the town of Jodhba He did what was evil in the eyes of the Lord Two years in Jerusalem, a short and dark time He walked in the ways of His Father's sin Bowing down to idols, leaving the Lord behind Two years in Jerusalem, a heavy, heavy crowd He served the idols That Manasseh
